clauses.reason: Section 1 adds to section 1 of Executive Order 10900 a subsection (d) under which the Secretary of Agriculture, after consultation, "shall transmit" to the Congress "all reports required by Section 408 of the Act". Under owner ruling 2026-10-21-strike-and-insert.md the added subsection continues as part of Executive Order 10900 until that order ends. Executive Order 12220 of June 27, 1980, section 1-501, revokes Executive Order 10900 as amended, and is effective on signing, so the first end is June 27, 1980 (actor: the President by Executive Order 12220; mechanism: express revocation of the amended parent). Executive Order 12220 reissues the reporting direction in its own text, which is a separate command and not a continuation of this clause.

Section 2 amends Executive Order 10900 by revoking "Section 5 thereof and redesignating Sections 6, 7 and 8" as sections 5, 6 and 7. Under owner ruling 2026-10-21-strike-and-insert.md the amendment continues as part of Executive Order 10900 until that order ends, which Executive Order 12220, section 1-501, effected on June 27, 1980 by revoking Executive Order 10900 as amended. The alternative reading, that this one-time instruction was exhausted when executed on January 19, 1977, is disclosed for the reviewer; the later date is used for consistency with the amendment ruling and does not change the order-level end because section 1 also ends on June 27, 1980.

research_rationale:
Executive Order 11963 of January 19, 1977 (42 FR 4325) has two sections, both amending Executive Order 10900 of January 5, 1961 (administration of the Agricultural Trade Development and Assistance Act of 1954): section 1 adds a subsection (d) to section 1 of Executive Order 10900 directing the Secretary of Agriculture, after consultation with named officials, to transmit to the Congress the reports required by section 408 of the Act, and section 2 revokes section 5 of Executive Order 10900 and redesignates sections 6, 7 and 8 as 5, 6 and 7. Under owner ruling 2026-10-21-strike-and-insert.md an amendment continues, as part of the amended order, until the parent order ends. Executive Order 12220 of June 27, 1980 (45 FR 44245), section 1-501, revokes Executive Order 10900 as amended; it takes effect on signing and states no later date. That is the first end for both sections. The same reporting direction is reissued independently in Executive Order 12220, so the function continues under a different order. The reading that section 2, an instruction executed when issued, was exhausted on January 19, 1977 and only its consequence survived is the alternative a reviewer should see; it would not change the order-level end date of June 27, 1980, which is set by section 1. The 7 U.S.C. 1691 note in the U.S. Code release point 119-121 lists this order as an amending order of Executive Order 10900 and carries that order's ended status line.
